svg.title: Functional warehouse site plan
svg.desc: An 84 by 78 metre synthetic site. Trucks enter at the east gate, follow a one-way road past receiving and dispatch, turn around the west and south, and leave through a separate exit gate. The warehouse, service workshop and office connect without crossing the truck road. One marked pedestrian crossing controls the shared forklift connector.
svg.text: 84 × 78 m · synthetic game layout · one-way truck route · separate service connector
Loading closes the lane; following traffic waits
One-way horseshoe; separate entry and exit.
R and D are inline stops; receiving leaves first.
Separate connector; only one unit in the shared throat.
One marked crossing of the forklift connector.
